verify.note: The signature is over the ASCII of sealSha256, not over raw bytes of the digest.

establishes: That this seal is byte-for-byte the seal that was signed by the holder of this key.
does_not_establish: That the cited sources are true.
That the key holder is any particular person.
Anything about claims the seal itself marks as testimony or unresolved.
distinct_from: app/lib/ed25519-keys.ts — that pair signs the story chain and has its private key committed on purpose, as a protocol demo. It is not this key and carries no attestation weight.
